description: This Java source file defines a utility class NoteMapper for converting between Note entity objects and their corresponding Data Transfer Objects (DTOs), NoteRequest and NoteResponse. It provides static methods to map a Note entity to a response DTO and to apply request data to a Note entity.

classes.name: NoteMapper
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to map between Note entity objects and their DTO counterparts, NoteRequest and NoteResponse.

methods.name: toResponse
methods.description: Converts a Note entity to a NoteResponse DTO.

methods.name: applyRequest
methods.description: Updates or creates a Note entity based on data from a NoteRequest DTO.
